description: The worked example from Prometheus and Grafana for Mere Mortals: CPU, memory, load, and disk for one machine running node_exporter. Every panel is one PromQL query.

panels.description: 100 minus the idle share. The same expression as the HighCpuBusy alert rule.
panels.title: CPU busy %

panels.description: Used as Prometheus sees it: total minus MemAvailable, which counts reclaimable cache as available.
panels.title: Memory used %

panels.description: Run-queue length over the last minute. Sustained load above the CPU count means work is queueing.
panels.title: Load average (1m)

panels.description: Point mountpoint at the filesystem you care about. A disk fills at its own pace; this is the panel that buys you warning.
panels.title: Disk used % (root filesystem)

title: One Machine, Honestly
